title: Independent final audit of PMS v1
description: Independently audit PMS v1 architecture, project memory accuracy, ADR and task records, JSON/JSONL, Python utilities, preservation, and fresh-agent onboarding without modifying repository work.
acceptance_criteria: Inspect exact Git baseline and complete worktree.
Audit PMS architecture, project-memory evidence, ADRs, tasks, JSON/JSONL, utilities, preservation, and onboarding.
Report critical issues without silently modifying implementation or historical records.
Distinguish independent findings from implementation-agent self-reporting.

Run validation and CLI commands where available.
verification_evidence: Independent audit found 17 of 18 PMS tests passing and one history test failure caused by state-dependent expectations.

The audit confirmed no application-source changes and byte-for-byte preservation of the Lovable-managed AGENTS.md section.
